_label: Kontakion of the Martyrs Paramon and Philumenus (11-29), Liturgy

commemoration.title: Martyr Paramon and 370 Martyrs in Bithynia

_note: Sibling of paramon-troparion. The parish sings the OCA engraved sheet (© 2009, Russian Imperial Court Chant): you/your and "Philumenus"; the closing "Always fervently intercede with Christ on behalf of the world" is printed as a bracketed cue on p.5 and set in full on p.6 — it is the end of THIS kontakion, not a separate Theotokion. Guarded on the tt row 40579 as fixed 2026-11-25 ("didst renounce", was the stemmer's "didst renounc").

_provenance.family_note: OCA. Identical to the troparia row it stands in for.

value.text:
Urged on by the commandments of God,
with patience, thou didst cleanse thy souls from all defilement.
Thou didst reach perfection as spiritual athletes;
thou didst renounce sacrifice to idols.
Imitating Christ, thou wast slain with a spear,
most blessed Paramon and Philoumenus.
Always fervently intercede with Christ on behalf of the world.
